title: Best Soundbars at Every Level (Entry, Middle & Upper Range)
body:
Looking for recommendations on the best value soundbars currently available. Would help if there was a range for other users too. I myself would aim for middle to upper range.
Suggested price brackets:
Lower end: below $400
Middle: $400–$700
Upper: $700+
Would be helpful to know:
Best models to watch for on sale
Whether rear speakers are worth paying extra for
Keen to hear what OzBargain users think are the current sweet spots.
